target_customer: Enterprises running AI agents in production who want lower cost per task
problem: Agents do not improve from experience; teams struggle to debug, test and train them from production data.
business_model: Enterprise B2B platform sold by demo (pricing not public)
product_category: AI agent training, evaluation and optimization

founders.name: Abhinav Sinha
education: Stanford, BS and MS Computer Science (AI)

founders.name: Andy Liang
education: Stanford, BS and MS Computer Science (AI)
previous_startups: GrocerCheck, COVID-19 web app with over 200,000 users (outcome not stated)

founders.name: Jeremy Tian
education: Stanford, BS and MS Computer Science (AI)

technical_complexity.rationale: Training custom models and harnesses with LoRA SFT, distillation and GRPO plus production tracing is hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Production trace data per customer helps, but observability and evaluation vendors are numerous.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found as of 2026-11; observability vendors broadened to evaluation.

market_need_then: Launch HN (2025-07) said observability users naturally wanted evaluation; demand evidence is anecdotal.

identity.logo: SVG mark; Brandfetch lists periwinkle, light gray and near black

brand_strength.rationale: Name resembles Lucid brands; no brand press, small footprint.

pivots.from: Debug, test and evaluate AI agents in production (Launch HN)
pivots.to: Training platform that optimizes harnesses and co-trains models (2026 site)
pivots.why: Not stated; evaluation demand led to training per later positioning

outcome_analysis: Lucidic launched as agent observability in July 2025 and by 2026 pitched agent training with enterprise logos on its site and a SOC badge. Funding is not public, so success is unclear; a crowded observability market pushed a repositioning toward training.
notes: Customer logos and benchmark results are self reported. Funding search found no amount (a data page mentions undisclosed family office investors). Competitor sources are 2026 vendor roundups so the as of founding list is empty.
